name: ship-microcorp-stalker
summary: Grey hard-surface fighter: a shiny conical nose, a round dark cockpit, a narrow neck with two red lights, a wide rear body with bright strakes and a red engine glow, and two forward-swept angular wings.

traits: round dark glass ring, about 3x4 px
lighter centre pixel (col 11, row 8) is a glint
glossy, crisp edge, raised 1-2 px in its housing
features.note: Round dark cockpit behind the nose; must read as distinct dark glass.

traits: conical, tapers from 5 px to a point at row 0
shiny metal: the bright strip at cols 10-11 is specular sheen
straight taper
features.note: The shiny pointed nose cone; tapering in width and height.

traits: forward-swept: tip at col 1-2 row 11, straight bright leading edge diagonal to the body at row 17
flat plate, crisp straight edges, stepped trailing edge
tilted up toward the tip
features.note: Left wing pointing forward and out; its bright leading edge and sharp tip must read.

traits: forward-swept: tip at col 20-21 row 11, straight bright leading edge to the body at row 17
flat plate, crisp straight edges
tilted up toward the tip
features.note: Right wing, mirror of the left.

traits: two red lights, 1x2 px each, at cols 8 and 14
on the sides of the narrow neck
glowing red
features.note: Red side lights on the neck between the cockpit and the body; both must stay visible and red.

traits: red-orange glow (cols 10-12, row 25) in a dark nozzle
short nozzle at the tail
emissive
features.note: Engine at the back with its orange-red glow; must read as glowing nozzle.

traits: two bright straight strakes (cols 7 and 15, rows 17-20)
crisp raised edges where wings meet the body
faint lighter spine at col 10
features.note: Bright strakes along the body's shoulders; crisp lines, not soft.

traits: narrower than cockpit section and body (5 px)
lighter panel at rows 12-14
straight sides
features.note: The narrow waist between the cockpit section and the wide rear body.

traits: wide, straight-sided rear fuselage, 7 px
darker right half (cols 12-13) is sprite shading
hard panels, tapering at the back
features.note: The wide rear body between the wings, feeding the engine.

concept.source: Gemini (Nano Banana) high-res reimagining of the level-frame sprite, 2026-10-28, with the user's prompt (same overhead outline, don't take pixels literally)
concept.use: Design guide for what each part is and its shape language; the sprite decides the top-view outline, proportions and colours.
